name: Exp_VortexIndicator_Duplex
summary: This EA trades based on the Vortex Indicator, which identifies trend direction by comparing positive and negative directional movement. It opens buy positions when the positive vortex line crosses above the negative line, and sell positions on the reverse crossover. The 'Duplex' variant likely operates on both entry and exit signals derived from the same indicator crossover logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于涡旋指标(Vortex Indicator)进行交易，通过正负方向运动线的交叉来判断趋势方向。当正方向线上穿负方向线时开多仓，反之开空仓。Duplex版本可能在入场和出场两端都使用同一指标的交叉信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Vortex Indicator的趋势跟踪系统。Vortex Indicator由VI+（正向运动线）和VI-（负向运动线）两条线组成，当VI+上穿VI-时表示上升趋势启动，产生做多信号；当VI-上穿VI+时表示下降趋势启动，产生做空信号。入场条件完全依赖这两条线的交叉，属于典型的趋势跟随型策略。出场条件同样基于反向交叉信号，即持有多头时VI-上穿VI+则平仓，持有空头时VI+上穿VI-则平仓，这体现了Duplex双向交易的设计理念。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数(Lot)参数供用户设置固定交易量，但没有看到基于账户余额或风险的动态仓位计算功能。资金管理方面，EA可能提供了止损和止盈参数，但核心依赖指标反转信号出场，趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the Vortex Indicator. The Vortex Indicator consists of two lines: VI+ (positive directional movement) and VI- (negative directional movement). When VI+ crosses above VI-, it signals the start of an uptrend and generates a buy signal; when VI- crosses above VI+, it signals a downtrend and generates a sell signal. Entry conditions rely entirely on these crossover events, making it a classic trend-following approach. Exit conditions are also based on reverse crossovers — a long position is closed when VI- crosses above VI+, and a short position is closed when VI+ crosses above VI-, reflecting the Duplex dual-direction trading design. Position sizing uses a fixed lot parameter provided by the user, without dynamic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. Money management may include stop-loss and take-profit parameters, but the primary exit mechanism relies on indicator reversal signals, which means the strategy is vulnerable to whipsaw losses in ranging or choppy markets.

pros: Vortex Indicator对趋势识别较为灵敏，能较快捕捉趋势启动
双向交易逻辑清晰，入场和出场规则一致性强
策略原理简单易懂，参数较少，便于优化和调整
趋势行情中表现良好，能抓住较长的单边行情
pros_en: The Vortex Indicator is responsive in detecting trend initiation, capturing new trends relatively early
Dual-direction trading logic is clear and consistent between entry and exit rules
Simple strategy principle with few parameters makes it easy to optimize and adjust
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing extended directional moves
cons: 在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假交叉信号，导致连续亏损
固定手数交易缺乏动态风险管理，无法根据市场波动调整仓位
依赖指标反转信号出场可能导致盈利大幅回撤，缺少移动止损保护
未设置强制止损时风险敞口过大，单笔亏损可能不可控
cons_en: Prone to frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic risk management, unable to adjust position size based on market volatility
Relying on indicator reversal signals for exits may lead to significant profit drawdowns without trailing stop protection
Without mandatory stop-loss, risk exposure is unlimited and single-trade losses can be uncontrolled
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中减少交易频率以避免虚假信号
实现基于账户风险的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数设置
加入移动止损(Trailing Stop)功能，在趋势运行中锁定部分利润
improvements_en: Add an ADX or volatility filter to reduce trading frequency in ranging markets and avoid false signals
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot size
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in partial profits during trend continuation

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易连续止损，需配合趋势强度过滤器
默认止损为0意味着如果不手动设置，持仓风险无上限
固定手数无法根据市场波动调整，在高波动期可能承受过大风险
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy is prone to consecutive stop-outs in ranging markets; a trend strength filter is needed
Default stop-loss of 0 means unlimited risk exposure if not manually configured
Fixed lot size cannot adapt to market volatility, potentially taking excessive risk during high-volatility periods
